users.title: Users
users.description: Manage public user accounts and organization membership.
users.searchPlaceholder: Search by email or display name…
users.organizationUpdateFailed: Could not update the user's organization.
users.disableConfirmation: {{name}} will not be able to sign in. Existing sessions will stop working on the next request.
users.enableConfirmation: {{name}} will be able to sign in again.

registration.title: Registration settings
registration.description: Choose which registration methods are available to public users.
registration.modeBothDescription: Allow registration with a password or an organization account.
registration.modeOidcOnlyDescription: Allow new accounts through the configured organization identity provider.
registration.modeClosedDescription: Do not allow new public accounts.
registration.domainsHelp: Enter one domain per line. Leave empty to allow any email domain.
registration.passwordEmailNotice: Password registration checks the entered email address only; it does not verify mailbox ownership.
registration.loadFailed: Could not load registration settings. Registration was left unchanged.

organizations.title: Organizations
organizations.description: Create organizations and control whether their users can sign in.
organizations.name: Name
organizations.enableConfirmation: Enable {{name}} so its members can sign in.
organizations.disableConfirmation: Disable {{name}}? Its members will not be able to sign in, and existing sessions will stop working on the next request.

admins.title: Administrators
admins.description: Create and manage platform and organization administrators.
admins.searchPlaceholder: Search username, email, or display name…
admins.passwordHelp: Leave blank for organization account only. If organization sign-in is unavailable, a password is required.
admins.passwordRequiredWhenOidcUnavailable: Enter a password because organization sign-in is unavailable.
admins.oidcUnavailable: Organization account sign-in is unavailable. New administrators need an initial password.
admins.cannotDisableSelf: You cannot disable your own administrator account.
admins.cannotDisableLastPlatformAdmin: At least one active platform administrator must remain.
admins.enableConfirmation: Enable {{name}} so this administrator can sign in again.
admins.disableConfirmation: Disable {{name}}? Password and organization account sign-in will be blocked, and existing sessions will stop working on the next request.
admins.unbindConfirmation: Remove the local binding for {{name}}? This does not disable the identity provider account. The same verified identity may bind again if it still matches this email.

runTracing.pageDescription: Review model turns, tool calls, durations and failure points from Canonical Run/Event records.
runTracing.otlpNote: OTLP export does not affect this page
runTracing.noMatchingRunsHint: Adjust the search term or status filter.
runTracing.runIdCopyFailed: Copy failed, please select the Run ID manually
runTracing.noSelection: Select a Run on the left to inspect its execution trace.
runTracing.limitedBody: This record was created before model lifecycle events were enabled. Committed tool and terminal events are still available, but the system never guesses or backfills model spans.
runTracing.emptyBody: This Run completed right after initialization, keeping only the Run root node and its terminal state.
runTracing.parentFallbackNote: Parent source unconfirmed, attached to the Run root node

diagnostic.parentSourceUnavailable: parent_source_unavailable · model parent not guessed, attached to the Run root
diagnostic.unknownParent: unknown_parent · parent node not covered by this event set
diagnostic.cyclicParent: cyclic_parent · parent cycle detected, attached to the Run root
diagnostic.missingSpanId: missing_span_id · event without span ID, derived from the source call ID
diagnostic.noTracingEvents: no_tracing_events · this Run has no tracing events
